Bug_Details:
This code creates a database connect using a hardcoded, constant password. Anyone with access to either the source code or the compiled code can
    easily learn the password.
Bug_Explanation: The password used to connect to the database is hardcoded and can be easily accessed by anyone with access to the source code or the compiled code.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by using a hardcoded constant database password.
